name: RC-B10–0222/2024 – Motion for a resolution
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the human rights situation in Kyrgyzstan, in particular the case of Temirlan Sultanbekov
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for the release of Temirlan Sultanbekov, an opposition party leader in Kyrgyzstan held in pre-trial detention on vote-buying charges. It says the case may be politically motivated and that his health is failing after a hunger strike. It also asks Kyrgyzstan to stop pressuring opposition parties, independent journalists and human rights defenders, and to respect the human rights commitments it made in its agreements with the European Union.

- The Parliament demands Sultanbekov's release; Kyrgyzstan's authorities decide whether to comply.
- It asks Kyrgyzstan to drop charges against activists and journalists and stop intimidation.
- The EU delegation is told to raise these concerns; further EU action is only a possibility.
